newsitem.title: USA: Liggett says grand jury probe into council.
newsitem.headline: Liggett says grand jury probe into council.

text.p: Liggett Group Inc, a unit of Brooke Group Ltd, said Thursday it "understands" there is a grand jury probe regarding possible criminal violations relating to the Council for Tobacco Reasearch-USA Inc.
In a quarterly filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the cigarette manufacturer said the investigation is being conducted by the U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of New York.
In the filing, the company said at one time it was a sponsor of the council.
Liggett said it is unable "at this time" to predict the outcome of this investigation.
